name: uno-discord-activity
description: Discord Activity de UNO em tempo real (Embedded App SDK + Socket.io)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
